figure_alt: Horizontal dot-and-interval chart of the 20 largest gaps in signifier Yes rates between movie-lover Yes and No groups on the same survey dates. Film lover has by far the largest gap, followed by Marvel fan and Disney fan. All dots favor the movie-lover Yes group, and half the uncertainty intervals cross zero.
prompt: Report the 20 signifiers that are most diagnostic of a movie lover Yes versus No endorsement. Discuss the potential meaning more than methodology.
title: What goes with calling yourself a movie lover?
